dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the residents of the City of Ouray, Colorado, and visitors using the local open space and recreational facilities.
dimensions.evidence: To direct the Secretary of Agriculture to convey to the City of Ouray, Colorado, certain land managed by the Forest Service, together with a reservoir.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers fee simple title of approximately 45 acres of land and associated water rights/infrastructure to the city, transferring full maintenance and operational responsibilities for Full Moon Dam.
dimensions.evidence: As a condition of the conveyance of the Federal land under subsection (b), the City shall agree--effective beginning on the date of the conveyance, to assume responsibility for the costs of all repairs

dimensions.assessment: Involves minor administrative and survey costs divided between the Secretary and the City, with no major federal spending implications.
dimensions.evidence: The City shall pay all costs associated with any surveys conducted for the purpose of accomplishing the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: Limited local conveyance of a specific federal property, water rights, and easements without creating broad new federal programs or agency authorities.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Forest Service to convey specified property and water rights in Ouray County, Colorado, to the City of Ouray

dimensions.assessment: Permanently transfers land title and establishes perpetual easements, conditions, and reversionary interests lasting indefinitely.
dimensions.evidence: to maintain the Federal land in perpetuity as open space

importance_detail.rationale: This bill directs a specific land and water rights conveyance from the federal government to the City of Ouray, Colorado, primarily impacting local recreational access, municipal water management, and local infrastructure responsibilities.
